data.title: 阿斯特蕾亚 · 晨光羽落的忠诚依偎
data.description: 金灿灿的初阳洒在纯白的床单上，几根洁白的羽毛散落在凌乱的枕席间。阿斯特蕾亚侧躺在被窝里，单手护着胸前滑落的睡衣，白皙修长的双腿在晨曦中展露出毫无修饰的自然美感。她微微仰起头，金色眸子中盛满了像向日葵般灿烂的笑容，满心欢喜地迎接着两人同在的清晨。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with white ruffled sheets
data.action: 侧躺在被窝里，单手护着胸前滑落的睡衣
data.lighting: golden morning sunshine warming the entire bedroom with vibrant glow
data.promptProse: Resting on her side across sun-drenched white bedsheets scattered with white feathers, Astraea wears a pure white gossamer slip chemise trimmed with soft swan feathers along its sweetheart neckline. Lightly holding the slipping fabric at her chest as her angel wings spread across the mattress, she smiles radiantly in warm morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side across sunlit white ruffled sheets scattered with downy feathers, she catches the slipping neckline of her feather-trimmed white gossamer chemise with one hand and beams with a bright morning blush. Golden sunbeams fill the cozy bedroom.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure white gossamer slip chemise trimmed with soft downy swan feathers along its sweetheart neckline and airy micro-hem, slipping slightly at one shoulder.
